text: Install Phaser as an npm package into a JS toolchain
quote: npm install phaser

text: Official CLI scaffolds projects from official templates and demo games
quote: This CLI tool presents an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games.

text: Phaser can be included directly from the jsDelivr CDN via a script tag
quote: Phaser is on jsDelivr which is a "super-fast CDN for developers".

text: Full TypeScript type definitions ship with the library for editor autocompletion
quote: Full TypeScript definitions can be found inside the types folder

text: Game logic is organized into Scenes that can be paused, resumed, slept, and run concurrently
quote: you can pause, resume and sleep a Scene at will, and that you can easily run multiple Scenes at the same time.

text: Built-in Arcade Physics gives sprites velocity, acceleration and gravity control
quote: This will allow you to control the Sprite using the built-in physics functions, such as velocity, acceleration, gravity, etc.

text: Unified input system works consistently across browsers and devices
quote: Phaser maintains a unified input system that works across all browsers and devices.

text: Loader supports many asset types: images, atlases, spritesheets, fonts, audio, JSON
quote: Common asset types include images, texture atlases, sprite sheets, fonts, audio files and JSON data, but there are many more that Phaser can handle.

text: Animation Manager plays sequences of frames as sprite animations
quote: Animations are created via the Animation Manager.

text: Visual editor lets you drag-and-drop objects, tweak animations and physics bodies, add effects
quote: Drag and drop objects into place, tweak their animations, adjust their physics bodies, enable special effects and more as you go.

text: Official MCP Server exposes 40+ tools and integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot
quote: For power users, the MCP Server goes deeper. It implements over 40 specialised tools and integrates directly with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible tools.

text: Phaser Game Agent MCP server lets you build games from inside your existing editor
quote: Build games from inside the editor you already use with the Phaser Game Agent MCP server.

text: Describe changes in plain language and the agent calls the right tools for you
quote: You describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you.

text: Active licences or subscriptions can be transferred to another registered user
quote: You can transfer any active licence or subscription to another registered Phaser user from your account page.

text: Games can be compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and other native apps via third-party tools
quote: compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native apps using 3rd party tools

text: Development can be done in either JavaScript or TypeScript
quote: You can use JavaScript or TypeScript for development.

text: Games can be deployed to the web, YouTube Playables, Discord Activities, Reddit games and Twitch Overlays
quote: Games can be built for the web, or as YouTube Playables, Discord Activities, Reddit games, Twitch Overlays or compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native apps using 3rd party tools.

text: Supports integration with 40+ front-end frameworks including React and Vue
quote: Phaser supports over 40 different front-end frameworks including React and Vue.

text: Scene Editor Inspector lets you add real-time visual filters like Glow, Blur, Pixelate, ColorMatrix
quote: Add and configure filters visually — Glow, Shadow, Blur, Pixelate, Bokeh, ColorMatrix, Displacement and more — directly in the Scene Editor's Inspector view, in real time.

text: Editor includes pixel art, tilemap and atlas editors plus SFX/music generation tools
quote:
Pixel art, tilemap & atlas editors
*   SFX & music generation

text: Editor supports bulk actions like renaming many objects or reorganizing layers at once
quote: Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers, rename a bunch of objects — it handles it without switching tools.

text: Full commercial rights are granted and licences can be transferred between users
quote:
Full commercial rights
*   Transfer your licence to any user

text: Built-in code editor provides IntelliSense-style autocompletion
quote: Code editor with IntelliSense

text: Games can be published with a single click
quote: Publish games with one click

text: Arcade Physics is a lightweight system limited to rectangle and circle collision shapes
quote: It's a lightweight physics system that can only handle two different types of physics shapes: rectangles and circles.

text: Built-in AI assistant can generate a whole game from a text prompt, including a random-idea option
quote: What game do you want me to make? Click Surprise Me for a random idea!

text: Project files can be exported out to work directly in VS Code
quote: any games you created will still work — they are not linked to the licence. You can also transfer your project files to VS Code.
